items.title: Website design and development
items.text: Up to five agreed pages, adapted for desktop, tablet, and mobile. Includes organization and light editing of the business information you provide.

items.title: Clear paths to get in touch
items.text: Calls to action tailored to your business, such as calling, submitting a contact form, or linking to your existing booking page. Your supplied photos, reviews, and credentials help build trust.

items.title: Basic website analytics
items.text: Basic analytics setup to help you understand website traffic. With ongoing management, we review available traffic and inquiry data and recommend next steps.

items.title: Optional ongoing management
items.text: Hosting, SSL, platform-appropriate maintenance, monthly checks, and a brief monthly summary. Includes up to 30 minutes of requested content updates each month; unused time does not roll over.

services.eyebrow: Web design and website management services
services.heading: A website built to turn visitors into customers.

steps.title: Get your free working prototype
steps.text: Send your existing website or a quick summary of your business. John will email a link to your free working prototype within 72 hours of reaching out. No sales call required.

steps.title: Agree on the proposal
steps.text: If you want to take your prototype further, we discuss your priorities. Before the full website build begins, you receive a written proposal defining the pages, included work, price, payment schedule, and estimated build timeline.

steps.title: Design, build, and review
steps.text: Once the proposal is accepted, the deposit is paid, and your materials are ready, we design and build the agreed pages. Your project includes two rounds of consolidated revisions. Additional work is quoted for approval first.

steps.title: Approve and launch
steps.text: After your final approval and remaining build payment, we launch the site following checks of navigation, links, and forms. If you choose ongoing management, it starts at launch.
